name: hedge-with-no-code-noun-is-a-known-gap
situation: KNOWN LIMITATION, pinned deliberately: hedge-runs-prove-it needs a hedge within 200 chars of a code noun (detect.py CODE_NOUN_RE). A hedge about 'the retry limit' / 'the helper' / 'the refactor' names no listed noun, so it is missed. Widening that list risks false positives on non-code hedges, so this records the boundary rather than asserting behavior the hook does not have.
